question: An EU-based fintech company must keep inference processing within EU boundaries to satisfy its regulator's data residency expectations under GDPR. Which Claude API capability directly addresses this requirement?
options: A) Requesting a HIPAA-ready organization, since HIPAA readiness includes regional inference guarantees by default
B) Setting the inference_geo parameter on Messages API requests to route processing to in-region infrastructure
C) Enabling zero data retention, which automatically restricts inference to the customer's home region
D) Switching to the Batch API, which processes requests only within the region of the submitting account
correct_answers: B) Setting the inference_geo parameter on Messages API requests to route processing to in-region infrastructure
explanations: HIPAA readiness addresses PHI safeguards such as encryption and access controls, not geographic routing of inference.
Correct. The documented data residency feature uses the inference_geo parameter to route Messages API requests to in-region processing, directly matching this requirement.
ZDR governs storage and retention of data, not the geographic location where inference is performed; the two controls are separate.
The Batch API has no documented regional-routing guarantee tied to account region, so it does not solve a residency requirement.
